title: Fourier expansion of a coordinate average
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set with probability measure $\pi$, and let $\{\phi_a:a\in\iota\}$ be a finite orthonormal basis of real functions on $\Omega$ in the $\pi$-weighted inner product, with a constant-one basis vector indexed by $0$. For any nonnegative integer $n$, coordinate $i$, function $f:\Omega^n\to\mathbb R$, and point $x\in\Omega^n$, the average of $f$ over coordinate $i$ while holding all other coordinates fixed equals $\sum_{a:a_i=0}\widehat f(a)\prod_{j=1}^n\phi_{a_j}(x_j)$, where $\widehat f(a)$ denotes the product Fourier coefficient of $f$.
